verdict.rationale: A corporate registry could plausibly offer event subscriptions such as filing-change callbacks, so the axis applies. However, the pack documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The only event mechanism is an email notice when directors, office address, name or status change, which is an adjacent notification channel and not a webhook. The probe also found that the registry documents no transactional API on any surface checked.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
